23 Nov 2026 · Press release

Listening evening: Laments of the Suusamyr, 26 November

Recordings made by Aigul Choro kyzy in the Suusamyr from 1968, with Cholpon Kasym kyzy's lament for her brother. Reading room, room 214, 18:00. Free; please bring your passport for the porter's desk.

14 Dec 2026 · Press release

Listening evening: Hymns in three voices, 17 December

Church hymns sung in three voices in village houses, recorded between 1969 and 1991. Reading room, room 214, 18:00. Free.

21 Dec 2026 · Press release

Reading room over the holidays

The reading room is closed from 25 December to 4 January. Requests for copies sent in the holidays will be answered from 5 January.

25 Jan 2027 · Press release

Listening evening: Lullabies and counting songs, 28 January

Lullabies and children's counting songs from the 1970s and 1980s collections. Families with children are welcome. Reading room, room 214, 18:00.

22 Feb 2027 · Press release

Listening evening: The epic singers of 1968, 25 February

The first long recordings of epic singers, made on the Conservatory's Comet recorder in 1968. Reading room, room 214, 18:00.

22 Mar 2027 · Press release

Listening evening: Songs of the spring, 25 March

Songs for Nooruz and the first days on the pasture. Reading room, room 214, 18:00.

26 Apr 2027 · Press release

Listening evening: The toi, wedding songs, 29 April

Wedding songs from the villages of the Talas valley and the Aksay Plateau. Reading room, room 214, 18:00.

24 May 2027 · Press release

Listening evening: New recordings from the students' summer, 27 May

The Conservatory's students play what they recorded in the villages in summer 2026, with some of the singers in the room. Reading room, room 214, 18:00.

7 Jun 2027 · Press release

Students' summer collecting 2027

Students of the Conservatory go out to record in the villages again this summer. Families who would like a visit can write to un@korkom.org or leave a note with the porter.

5 Jul 2027 · Press release

Summer hours

In July and August the reading room is open Tuesday and Thursday only, 10:00 to 16:00.

6 Sep 2027 · Press release

The reading room reopens for the new year

The reading room is open on its usual days from 6 September. Listening evenings return in the autumn; dates will be announced here.
